author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Wizards of the Coast reportedly have remakes of Baldur's Gate 1 and 2 in development. While they have plans for a Baldur's Gate 4, it's likely a long ways off and a remake of the first two games would hopefully hold over fans during the wait. Baldur's Gate 1 and 2 already received Enhanced Editions that were basically souped up remasters, and it's unclear what form these remakes will take. In other news, James Gunn has shared the first official look of Nicholas Hoult in the Superman sequel, Man of Tomorrow, premiering next year. It features Hoult's Lex Luthor in full battle armor. And finally, we’re visiting How to Train Your Dragon’s Isle of Berk with the Ride Guys to fly through Hiccup’s Wing Gliders – all at Universal Orlando Resort.
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.
title: Baldur's Gate 2 Remake Reportedly Arriving Before Baldur's Gate 4 - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
We had the chance to sit down and play with PlayStation's newest hardware, the FlexStrike Fight Stick, 27-Inch Gaming Monitor, and Pulse Elevate Speakers. The FlexStrike Fight Stick is the first ever first party fight stick from Sony that works on both PlayStation 5 and PC wired or wireless. Built from the ground up with the FGC in mind, the FlexStrike is a comfortable, sleek, and modern fight stick for players of all skill levels. The buttons are clicky and the stick is customizible, and its easy to carry around, and if you REALLY wanted to, you could use it as a normal PlayStation 5 controller. 
The 27-Inch Gaming Monitor is a monitor developed by Sony for use with PlayStation 5 and PC. It features a 2560 x 1440 resolution and up to 240 Hz as well as a built-in charging hook for a PlayStation 5 Dual Sense controller. 
And finally, we took a look at PlayStation's Pulse Elevate Speakers which feature incredible sound and microphones so you can chat with teammates without needing to we
title: Hands On With PlayStation's New Fight Stick, Gaming Monitor, & Speakers

author: IGN
description:
Survive the Summer. Watch the trailer for The End of Oak Street, an upcoming film starring Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor. The End of Oak Street also stars Maisy Stella and Christian Convery.

After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

The film is written and directed by David Robert Mitchell and produced by J.J. Abrams, Hannah Minghella, Jon Cohen, David Robert Mitchell, Matt Jackson and Tommy Harper. The executive producers are Chris Bender, Jake Weiner, Joanne Lee and Leeann Stonebreaker.

Mitchell’s team behind the camera includes director of photography Michael Gioulakis, production designer Maya Shimoguchi, editor John Axelrad, composer Michael Giacchino and costume designer Erin Benach.

Warner Bros. Pictures Presents A Bad Robot Production, A Jackson Pictur
title: The End of Oak Street - Official Trailer (2026) Ewan Mcgregor, Anne Hathaway, Christian Convery
